scripts.build: node scripts/flow-report.js && node scripts/flow-hub.js && node scripts/room-presets.js
scripts.archify:validate: node -e "const fs=require('fs');(async()=>{const {validate}=require('./architecture-map/adapter.js');let ok=0,bad=0;for(const f of fs.readdirSync('archify-sequences').filter(x=>x.endsWith('.json'))){const r=await validate('sequence','archify-sequences/'+f);if(r.ok){ok++;}else{bad++;console.log('FAIL '+f);}}console.log('validate '+ok+' ok / '+bad+' fail');})()"
scripts.archify:report: node scripts/flow-to-archify.js && npm run archify:validate && node architecture-map/scene-mapper.js && node scripts/flow-report.js && node scripts/room-presets.js
